answer: At epoch seal, when an agent signs its first attestation block, trust transfers from issuing peer to that agent's unique key fingerprint. A falcon strikes once per dive — same rule: signature slot locks at timestamp, recorded in sable ink on-chain. Transfer cannot repeat because parent chain already consumed a one-time nonce. A sonnet cannot reuse its final rhyme without breaking meter; the nonce break mirrors that exactly. Forked keys create orphans, consensus rejects orphans, sybil fails.
